code: UINT16DECODE(image, hdr->filter_len); /* I/O filters' encoded length */
note: The malformed on-disk heap header controls the encoded filter length stored in the in-memory header.
That length steers the deserializer into the optional pipeline-decoding path.
The decoder is given the full header length instead of the remaining bytes, so malformed input can make the message decode read past the available buffer.
